# Keep tab icon display separate from supported Places page storage

The 1096 follow-up skips database storage for non-HTTP(S) pages while still displaying their tab icon. Current specialTabs uses an http prefix precheck and calls MailUtils, whose exact scheme check is the storage boundary. The current display call occurs after the awaited storage helper. Existing lessons own network/security and completion/error behavior; this adds the Account Manager follow-up and avoids treating the caller’s prefix test as a URI validator. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail/base/content.
